title: GridAI button no longer covers Save
problem: On computers the floating GridAI button sat on top of the Save button of save bars.
now: When a page has a save bar, the GridAI button sits above it.
steps: Change a product so the save bar shows.
The GridAI button sits above Save.
notes: Where: Add product, Settings pages, bulk editors

shots.label: A settings page with its save bar
